297267-KG.about_this_item: Gemon Adult Cat (от 12 месяцев) с курицей и индейкой — полнорационный корм для взрослых кошек: курица и индейка как источники незаменимых питательных веществ, рис как источник углеводов, высокая усвояемость благодаря экструзии. Пребиотики FOS и MOS для здоровья кишечника, юкка Шидигера против запаха фекалий, свежее мясо для вкуса и лососёвое масло для блестящей мягкой шерсти. Без искусственных красителей и консервантов.
297267-KG.ingredient_information:
Composition: Cereals (rice 4%), meat and animal derivatives 36% (fresh chicken meat 8%, fresh turkey meat 8%), oils and fats (salmon oil 0.5%), fish and fish derivatives, vegetables, derivatives of vegetable origin (fructo-oligosaccharides FOS 0.5% and yucca schidigera 0.1%), yeasts (mannan-oligosaccharides MOS 0.5%), minerals.

Analytical constituents: Crude Protein: 32%, Crude Fibre: 2.5%, Crude Fat: 13%, Crude Ash: 8.5%, n-3 Fatty Acids: 0.4%, n-6 Fatty Acids: 2.3%. Metabolized Energy: 3,925 kcal/kg.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES/kg: Vitamin A (Retinyl Acetate) 30,700 IU, Vitamin D3 1,610 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl-acetate) 72 mg, Choline Chloride 1,550 mg, Selenium (Sodium selenite 0.25 mg) 0.11 mg, Manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 52 mg) 16.9 mg, Zinc (Zinc oxide 98 mg) 78 mg, Copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 26.5 mg) 6.7 mg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 171 mg) 56 mg, Iodine (Calcium iodate anhydrous 1.38 mg) 0.9 mg, Taurine 1,200 mg, DL- Methionine (Technically pure): 1,000 mg. TECHNOLOGICAL ADDITIVES: Antioxidants.
297267-KG.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding intakes (see table) may be split into 2 daily meals. Individual nutritional requirements may vary due to size, age and living conditions of the animal. Fresh and clean water should be available at all times. When this product replaces another type of feed and/or diet it is recommended to introduce it gradually over a period of at least 1 week. Cat food only, not suitable for human consumption.
